for.zh: 養狗養貓的人：意外和疾病的醫療費，理賠可以直接付給動物醫院
for.en: Dog and cat owners: vet bills for accidents and illness, paid straight to the vet if you like

options.en: Small dog or a typical cat

options.zh: 短鼻品種（法鬥、英鬥、巴哥、波斯、異國短毛）
options.en: Flat-faced breed (French or English bulldog, pug, Persian, exotic shorthair)

questions.zh: 幾歲？（新投保限 14 歲以下）
有沒有已知的病或過去一年看過的病？（沒有就寫「沒有」）
questions.en: Any known conditions, or anything treated in the last year? ("none" if not)

coverages.zh: 意外和疾病的醫療（門診、住院、手術、檢查、藥）
coverages.en: Accident and illness care (visits, stays, surgery, tests, medicine)

coverages.zh: 寵物咬傷人或弄壞別人東西
coverages.en: Your pet bites someone or damages their things

coverages.zh: 意外或疾病身故的火化費
coverages.en: Cremation after death from accident or illness

addons.zh: 預防保健（每年疫苗、健檢、驅蟲、洗牙，定額給付）
addons.en: Preventive care (yearly vaccines, check-up, parasite control, dental cleaning, fixed amounts)

claims.en: A vet visit for an illness

claims.zh: 牠咬傷了人或別人的寵物
claims.en: They bit a person or another pet

clauses.zh: 「既往症」指在保單生效前或等待期內已出現症狀、已診斷或已治療的疾病或傷害，不論是否確診。
clauses.en: A "pre-existing condition" is any illness or injury with signs, a diagnosis or treatment before the policy started or during the waiting period, diagnosed or not.

clauses.zh: 「合格動物醫院」指依法設立並有執業獸醫師的動物醫院。收據須載明醫院名稱、日期、寵物名字或晶片號碼、診療項目與金額。
clauses.en: An "eligible vet" is a licensed animal hospital with a practising vet. Invoices must show the hospital, date, the pet's name or chip number, what was done and the amounts.

clauses.zh: 承保寵物因意外或疾病在合格動物醫院接受治療，我們支付醫療費用扣除你自付的比例，以每年保額為上限。你可以選擇由我們直接付款給動物醫院。
clauses.en: When the insured pet is treated at an eligible vet for an accident or illness, we pay the bill less your share, up to the yearly limit. You can have us pay the vet directly.

clauses.zh: 承保寵物造成第三人身體傷害或財物損失，你依法應負賠償責任時，我們代為賠償，每一事故最高 3 萬美元。
clauses.en: When you are legally liable because the insured pet hurt someone or damaged their property, we pay, up to $30,000 per event.

clauses.zh: 承保寵物因承保之意外或疾病死亡時，我們支付火化或安葬費用，最高 300 美元，不扣自付比例。
clauses.en: When the insured pet dies from a covered accident or illness, we pay cremation or burial, up to $300, with no share for you.

clauses.zh: 既往症不予理賠。但既往症在保單生效後連續 12 個月無症狀且未治療者，自第 13 個月起視為新發生。
clauses.en: No payment for pre-existing conditions. But one with no signs or treatment for 12 months in a row after the policy starts counts as new from the 13th month.

clauses.zh: 疾病的等待期為 14 日，意外的等待期為 2 日；等待期內發生的事故不予理賠。
clauses.en: Waiting periods: 14 days for illness, 2 days for accidents; nothing in a waiting period is paid.

clauses.zh: 結紮、繁殖、懷孕生產、美容、指甲修剪、行為訓練、寵物食品（處方飼料除外），以及可用疫苗預防而未施打疫苗之疾病，不予理賠。
clauses.en: No payment for spaying or neutering, breeding, pregnancy and birth, grooming, nail trims, training, food (except prescription diets), or illness a vaccine would have prevented when the pet wasn't vaccinated.

clauses.zh: 短鼻品種的呼吸道手術、髖關節發育不良在投保時未滿 1 歲者除外，其餘先天或遺傳性疾病，在保單生效前已知者不予理賠。
clauses.en: No payment for congenital or hereditary conditions known before the policy started, except airway surgery for flat-faced breeds and hip dysplasia in pets insured before their first birthday.

clauses.zh: 故意傷害、虐待、參與鬥犬或比賽造成的傷害，不予理賠。
clauses.en: No payment for harm done on purpose, cruelty, or injury from fighting or racing.

clauses.zh: 申請理賠時須提供動物醫院收據及診斷證明；手術或住院須另附病歷。請在治療後 90 日內申請。
clauses.en: To claim, give the vet's invoice and diagnosis; for surgery or a stay, the records too. Claim within 90 days of treatment.

clauses.zh: 投保時未告知已知疾病，或理賠時提供不實資料者，我們得拒絕理賠並終止保單。
clauses.en: If a known condition wasn't disclosed, or a claim includes false information, we may refuse it and end the policy.

clauses.zh: 直接付款給動物醫院時，我們付給醫院的金額為核定理賠金額；你自付的部分由你直接付給醫院。
clauses.en: When we pay the vet directly, we pay them the approved amount; you pay the vet your share.

clauses.zh: 預防保健：每年定額給付疫苗 60 美元、健康檢查 80 美元、體內外驅蟲 50 美元、洗牙 60 美元，不扣自付比例，不受等待期限制，未使用的額度不累積到下一年。
clauses.en: Preventive care: each year, fixed amounts for vaccines ($60), a check-up ($80), parasite control ($50) and dental cleaning ($60), with no share for you and no waiting period; unused amounts don't roll over.

clauses.zh: 保費月繳或年繳；月繳扣款失敗有 14 日寬限期，逾期停效，補繳後復效。可隨時退保，按未經過日數退費。保費的 20% 為 Cover 的固定費用，其餘進入理賠池；年度結算後剩餘捐給你選的公益團體。
clauses.en: Pay monthly or yearly; a failed payment has 14 days' grace, then lapses until paid. Cancel any time for a refund of the days left. 20% of the premium is Cover's flat fee, the rest the claims pool; what is left after the year goes to your chosen cause.
